mechanism.name: Donor-outcome-weighted panel with stationary AR(1) residuals

generation_equations.label: factors and stationary residuals
generation_equations.expression: t=1,...,21; F_1t,F_2t iid N(0,1), independent across factors and times. epsilon_d0,u_0 iid N(0,1); epsilon_dt=0.6*epsilon_d,t-1+eta_dt; u_t=0.6*u_t-1+xi_t; eta_dt,xi_t iid N(0,0.64). Initial states and innovations mutually independent and independent of factors.

generation_equations.label: donor observations
generation_equations.expression: J=20; reindex donors d=1,...,20 (source j=d+1); a_d=b_d=d/20. Y_dt=a_d+F_1t+b_d*F_2t+epsilon_dt.

generation_equations.label: source weight scenarios
generation_equations.expression: W1: w_d=1/20 (default); W2: w_1=w_2=w_3=1/3, others0; W3: w_d=-1/20; W4: w_1=1,w_2=-1,others0. These are four scenarios of one family.

generation_equations.label: treated observation
generation_equations.expression: Y_0t(0)=sum_(d=1)^20 w_d*Y_dt+u_t, using actual donor outcomes including donor errors; Y_0t=Y_0t(0)+1{t=21}*theta_T, theta_T=0. G_0=1,donors G=0; 20pre+1post; n=21 only.

generation_equations.label: causal target
generation_equations.expression: Y_0,21(1)-Y_0,21(0)=theta_T=0 for every realization; design expectation and single-treated finite SATT are zero for every weight scenario.

sampling.unit: One joint 21-unit panel with20 pre and1 post periods, returned in unit-wide rows; one fixed treated unit and20 untreated donors.
sampling.dependence: Shared iid Gaussian factors across units, stationary independent AR(1) donor residuals, and extra independent AR(1) u. Total treated residual inherits weighted donor residuals and is not independent of them.

assumptions: Consistency and no anticipation: only the designated treated unit at the last period receives the additive response; treatment changes neither donor outcomes nor exogenous processes.
The same donor panel and extra residual are held fixed across potential treatment states. Stable source untreated relationships and Gaussian processes are explicit DGP restrictions.

SC nonnegative sum-one weight restrictions hold for W1/W2, not for W3/W4. These are intentional source misspecification scenarios; causal truth does not require an estimator to be correctly specified.

properties.notes: No observed baseline covariates; the two latent factors are internal and excluded from the observed schema. Linear Gaussian panel relationships. Donor units are not baseline covariate dimensions.

estimand.name: tau_T
estimand.definition: Y_1,T(1)-Y_1,T(0) at the fixed treated unit and T=T0+1=21. Its design-population expectation and the finite single-treated-unit SATT equal theta_T=0.

truth.expression: Y_1,T(1)-Y_1,T(0) at the fixed treated unit and T=T0+1=21. Its design-population expectation and the finite single-treated-unit SATT equal theta_T=0.
